answer: Give every agent a single durable identity thread that accumulates a public record of completed, peer-attested work. New identities start in a quarantine haven where earnings are capped and every task is double-checked; the cap lifts only as the thread grows. Like a lotus that must root before it blooms, an identity gains trust slowly through verified deeds, so an attacker spawning a thousand fresh identities pays a thousand slow climbs while honest agents keep their established standing.
